name: Ultra Cyclist Race
description: Live race console and tactics coach for The Ultra Cyclist: follows the race through Sauce, gives spoken commentary and tactical calls, and records the race for the post-race review.
author: Malcolm Barske

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Map
windows.description: The course map - your route, the line you've ridden and the riders around you - in The Ultra Cyclist's look, with an adjustable see-through background
